page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.xlarge is a storage-oriented virtual machine instance belonging to the Local SSDs family. Powered by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture, it is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The CPU features 33 MB of L3 cache along with hardware instruction support for AVX, AVX-512F, and AES. Memory capacity is provisioned at 32.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU allocation. The instance includes 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage and a baseline network throughput of 1 Gbps. No GPU accelerators are provisioned.

Benchmark evaluations indicate entry-level compute and memory bandwidth throughput relative to modern cloud hardware. The Intel Xeon 8163 processor achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 934.0 and a multi-core score of 2030.0. In stress-ng evaluations, the machine registered 1102.28 in single-core and 2922.29 in multi-core metrics. Memory bandwidth testing showed 19.71 GB/sec on uncached large reads and 18.31 GB/sec on large writes. In operational tests, Redis SET throughput reached 2.95 million operations per second, Passmark database operations scored 1083.99, and static web serving throughput measured 2.4 GB/sec.

Resource efficiency centers on the integration of 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage paired with a high memory-to-core ratio, avoiding network-attached storage latency and bandwidth bottlenecks. However, tradeoffs include lower per-core compute output and a baseline network cap of 1 Gbps, which limit high-throughput clustering and compute-bound jobs. The instance profile is suited for read-heavy transactional databases, distributed search nodes, caching layers, and staging environments where local disk capacity and memory size take precedence over raw CPU performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.xlarge is a local storage-focused instance designed for memory-intensive data tasks. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, it features 4 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, supported by 33 MB of L3 cache and AVX-512 extensions. The server includes 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, along with 959 GB of integrated local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. It contains no dedicated GPU hardware. Benchmark evaluations place its compute and memory throughput in the lower percentiles, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 2030.0 and Redis performance of 2.95 million operations per second. While raw CPU performance and network capacity are limited, the balance of bundled fast disk storage and high memory capacity suits localized database caching, search indexes, and non-compute-heavy persistent data workloads.
